Tangning, the Ministry's quiet observer inside Xuanfang Hold, delivers his findings to Suoming. Following the Providence Lock the Sentinel once gave him, he went to the Sanctum and measured Hsin the Moon Fox's frequency, only to find it fading fast. The Manifold Sanctum at the Hold's heart could collapse at any moment. Hearing this, Suoming remembers a promise she made someone long ago. She decides to go to the Sanctum and see the truth for herself.
Hsin... Is She in the Heart of Frost right now?
I should keep moving.
{PlayerName}. My greetings have been remiss lately.
My new dwelling in the Xuanyuan Grotto-Heaven is newly raised. Sparrows sing from the eaves and the clouds drift in, a setting made for brewing tea and playing the qin.
Should a free day find you, I would welcome you most gladly.
Qingxiao?
Why so formal over comms again...
An invitation calls for proper manners. That said, I've grown more adept with these messages.
...In plainer words: if you're free, I'd like you to come sit a while at the Xuanyuan School's new training hall.
New training hall?
New training hall?
Yes, only just raised, with room enough for the disciples to practice the sword.
That's my Master. Heading there now.
A whole new training hall already? That's my Master.
Count me in for a visit, then. I'm available right now.
Wonderful.
Friend shared a location
I'll be waiting here for you.
How'd she put up a whole new training hall so fast?
It's Qingxiao, after all. She's probably got some secret art for it.
We'll know once we get there. If it's her hall...
Oh! I can kind of picture it. Bet it's one of those misty, immortal-looking places, huh?
You raise a fair point, Fourth Seal. If She wanted to see me, why not just bring me to Her side from the start?
A whim I could tolerate, but I suspect this is not Her doing at all.... Regardless, you may rest now. Thank you.
Walk with me through this, Ninth—
Sister Suoming!
Ninth...
Haha, long time no see! Did you miss me?
It's been, what, two hundred years? Since we took down that Evil Miasma that came from the Sentinel's assassination.
The sacrifice was heavy, but at least everyone's frequencies are safe in those locks of yours, right? We'll be together forever!
Wow, is that the Sentinel? Sister Suoming, can you take me to see Her?
Only if you stop being so rowdy.
Of course, Sister Suoming!

Suoming walks alone, murmuring to the frequencies sealed within her Locks. She takes out the one belonging to the Ninth Seal, and a rare smile crosses her face.

A moment later, the Ninth Seal stands beside her in the flesh, cheerfully catching up on old times. The sight dims Suoming's expression, but she says nothing of it, only lets the Ninth Seal's wish to "see the Sentinel" pass unchallenged.
Sister Suoming, did Huating become a better place after we killed off the "Evil Miasma"?
I never got to see it at peace. Is it beautiful?
Of course. It's our homeland.
Look, Sister Suoming! Doesn't that look like the mechanism teapot the Lord Second Seal made?
I remember when you stuffed Water Moon Buns into it and he chased you all over the courtyard!
But he'd always let it slide as long as you lent him the Vermillion Locks to play around with.
That wasn't for play. Because of him, the Locks were refined into what they are today.
So that... after you all died, I could seal your frequencies inside them.
Sister Suoming, these Autopuppets... Did the Sentinel abandon them here?
They were attacked. Stay alert.
Maybe the Lord Second Seal could fix them?
This is the Sentinel's technology. Even he would find it hard to repair.
Wait. Something's coming.
Haunting evils... Ninth, you—
That's right. Get to cover, Ninth...
Hmph. This place is not to be trifled with.
Stealing lines from me, Ninth?
Hehe, it's written all over your face!
The way these fiends are constructed is alarmingly similar to the Moon Fox's own handiwork.
Oh! Lord Second Seal! Long time no see! Back still aching? I can help, you know!
Enough of that. Focus on the work at hand.
Roger that!
Your timely aid is much appreciated, Intendant Suoming. I have heard much of you.
Mm. Were you ambushed by those fiends?
Indeed. They call themselves Formrenders and Soulfrayers. They are Autopuppets, but far more brutal than the rest of us.
Even the Kernel Puppets guarding us stood no chance. I suppose the technology used to forge them originates from...
I'm fully aware. It's too dangerous here. Let me escort you back to Mengxuan Vale first.
There is no need to trouble yourself, Intendant. The path we came from is safe enough.
Besides...
You have more pressing matters to attend to, don't you?
In the light of understanding, life and death lose their weight...
In the light of understanding, life and death lose their weight...
Were their modular parts broken?
Classic Formrender work. They can never be fixed.
Do you resent them? Your enemies... or the Sentinel who didn't aid in time?
Suoming...
We mourn for the deceased, but we still have a higher mission to achieve.
And you are just like us, Intendant Suoming. That we do know.
...Let's go, Ninth.
I heard those Celestial Autopuppets call you Intendant.
Hmph. Beating around the bush doesn't suit you. Well? Do you dislike the title?
It's not about liking it or not. It's just that no one will ever call you Seal Master again. That makes me a little sad.
Take this! Xuanyuan First Form, Hidden Heart!
Master Qingxiao never taught us that move... Cheater!
The immortal lady told us, "We train in the heart, not in the form." I came up with this myself!
{PlayerName}, you've come.
Greetings, Senior {Male=Brother;Female=Sister}!
Taking in disciples already, Master Sword Transcendent?
Just watching over the little ones for Jiuniang. Letting them run about.
I showed them a handful of forms, lest their wild horseplay leave them bruised. If they come to master my swordcraft in time, then the art lives on.
So this really is the Xuanyuan School's new training hall?
It's... the Xuanyuan School, Xianling Village Branch!
Look! I carved that plaque myself. "World's Greatest Cultivation School." Amazing, right?
It truly is a training hall, and we truly do train in the sword.
...Did my little joke fall rather flat?
Ah, so you were joking...
A martial school is not built in haste. There are many days to consider what comes next. This place suits well—no worldly dust, only kitchen smoke. No hindrance to cultivation.
And with the festival near, there are countless tasks needing hands. Staying here, I can at least be of some use.
Master Qingxiao can cut out a whole pile of Moon Lantern frames in one swing! Beats my whole day's work!
Getting ready for the Waking Moon Festival?
Yes. When the <te href=852014>festival</te> draws near, Xuanfang livens up. If you are free, do take a stroll through it.
Will you be going?
Is it true Hsin shows up at the festival?
...Mm. In the old days, if I did not attend, Hsin would send a Rafter Kite to fetch me, hounding me till I went.
It was true over a decade ago. But in recent years... Hsin appears more rarely.
I wish we could meet Lady Hsin! Grandma and Grandpa always say the Sentinel will come to play with us at the festival, but we've never seen Her, not once.
Don't you know? That's just grown-up talk to make us behave. Like the one about Autopuppets stealing kids who won't go to bed...
Hsin is... simply a little busy. You will have the chance to see Her some other day.
Your mother's here. Off you go.
Everything all right?
It's just... I'm still not quite used to minding such lively little ones.
Does it remind you of when you first met Ruoyun?
No... Hsin.
But let's return to the matter at hand.
I asked you here, in part, to talk about Hsin. These past few days... the presence I have sensed from Her has grown weaker than before.
Hsin keeps no set path, so a flickering presence is nothing new... She vanishes for a time, then reappears as if nothing happened, chattering of trifles.
In the past, Hsin never spoke of what She was doing, so I asked no further.

Yet with Xuanfang's portents growing more frequent, even the Rafter Kites no longer bring word of Her. Until moments ago, I sensed a wisp of Her presence near the Sanctum, but it was gone in a breath, too fleeting to catch.
...Hence my wish for you to accompany me to Xuanfang Hold to search for Her trail. And when the moment calls, I may need to rely on your power as Arbiter.
I understand.
Then let's head to the Hold first. There's something I've been wanting to look into as well.
Talk on the way?
Thank you. After all this is settled...
You'll invite me to dinner?
You'll take me to the Waking Moon Festival?
...So be it.

Qingxiao's "new training hall" turns out to be nothing more than an ordinary village courtyard, where she stands smiling as children tear around the yard. She catches your surprised look and admits it was only a joke, and she's simply watching the little ones while their parents prepare for the Waking Moon Festival.
 
Talk of the festival leads Qingxiao to her real reason for inviting you. Hsin's presence is growing fainter by the day, and she wants you with her when she investigates the area where she last sensed it, near the Sanctum. Recalling the rumors from the tea stall, you agree to go with her to Xuanfang Hold.
The two of them are going at it again... Someone find a Warden, quickly...
I'm not leaving. After everything we've been through, you want me to listen to some stranger?!
This is about keeping us safe... Won't you stop being so stubborn...!?
Ah, Paragon Qingxiao, {PlayerName}! Thank goodness you're here. Help me talk some sense into my father, please...
What's all this about?
Well, a while back, someone from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs said the Hold had "served its purpose" and would collapse any day now. Told us to move out while we could.
Ridiculous. Our family has lived in this land for generations. You don't just pack up and leave...
To be fair, I'm not convinced either. It came out of nowhere...
But that person carried an Intendant's command token. Clearly no small figure... And I'd rather not wait to find out. We can't survive another disaster like the Autopuppet rebellion...
Nothing's settled yet. No need to panic.
Something does feel off...
If you say so, {PlayerName}, I want to believe it. But the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs...
See? Even {PlayerName} thinks the same thing!
Paragon Qingxiao, my apologies for disturbing your cultivation. But there's been an emergency... It requires your attention.
It's no trouble. What's happened?
Someone tried to break into the Sanctum. We've detained her, but she claims to hold the Sentinel's token. Except... it's not in any of our records. No way to verify it.
Token...
Did she say where she came from?
She said... she's an Intendant in Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
...I see. {PlayerName} and I are bound for the Sanctum as we speak. We won't be long.

You come upon a family in the middle of an argument. Wanhong, an old man, refuses to leave the Land of Xuanfang, the only home he has ever known. His daughter Qingchen, however, is convinced the Hold is heading for another disaster and insists on moving the family out.
 
As father and daughter stand at an impasse, Qingxiao receives word from Liangyu: a woman claiming to be an Intendant of the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs tried to force her way into the Sanctum and was stopped by the Wardens.

You decide to head to the Sanctum and find out what's happening.
Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming?
Not anymore. But one thing still bothers me...
Well? Still have reservations about Intendant Suoming?
Not anymore. But... one thing still bothers me.
What happened before she joined the Ministry. The way she took the frequencies of her fallen comrades...
Hm. The omens of the Sanctum's fall aren't settled yet. Let's get through this first. I'll explain later.
What worries me more right now is the people. Our presence here has already—
Shh. Leave it for now.
The Sanctum's fall? What are you two talking about?
Are you the ones spreading rumors and causing all this panic?
That uniform... they're from Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
You must be... the Xuan Paragon of Xuanfang Hold, and this {Male=gentleman;Female=lady}... Never mind.
Why the evasion?
Forgive us. To us in the Ministry, {Male=he;Female=she} holds a special standing. Not something to speak of before outsiders.
Your Ministry governs Sentinel matters, so this is about...
Ah, I get it. Qingxiao already knows I'm the Arbiter. No need to dance around it.
We meant no disrespect, Arbiter. The situation demanded immediate action. We couldn't report in time.
Besides, the Intendant ordered us to stay silent. She said... you would surely arrive at the Sanctum at this time, and that all your questions would be answered there.
As for the panic this has caused, we'll help the Wardens contain it.
...I see. I understand your position. I won't make things more difficult.
But when this is all over, I want the full story.
You have my word, Arbiter. The Intendant... she came to safeguard Xuanfang.
You know this is the Sentinel's Sanctum. How dare you trespass?
Watcher Liangyu... The way you carry yourself reminds me of an old friend.
Paragon Qingxiao... and {PlayerName}. You've come!
Arbiter, we meet at last. I am Suoming.
And this... would be the Xuan Paragon. Qingxiao, I take it. A pleasure.
What's the situation?
She claims she came by decree to meet the Sentinel. And yes, we've confirmed that she really is an Intendant from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
But by custom, the Sentinel has to approve visitors first before an escort guides them in. And with Her absence of late, there's no way to know Her will.
Besides... if the Intendant truly came by decree, why sneak in through a side gate?
The people on the way over here spoke of "Xuanfang Hold's collapse." Did that rumor come from you?
Yes.
The Ministry detected that Hsin's frequency has become critically unstable, reaching its breaking point. As Her state and the Hold's are one, I acted to keep the people safe.
You're only just noticing this now?
Spare the probing questions. The Ministry's decisions and orders are not mine to disclose, Arbiter.
Hsin's <te href=750059>Prism of Fate</te>... I never imagined She would give this to you.
...What's that supposed to mean?
It means... She had a change of heart. She chose to trust you.
Paragon Qingxiao. You know Hsin the Moon Fox well. You understand what this token signifies.
That's... a Vermillion Lock...
It is a covenant. A deal between Hsin the Moon Fox and me. The time has come for Her to honor it. But as things stand, She may not even be able to save Herself.
We don't have much time.
Paragon, what does all this mean...?
It is Hsin's frequency within that lock. She speaks the truth.
So that presence you sensed earlier...
Came from this, yes.
Is that proof enough for you?
Hsin promised that when the time was right, she would give us and Xuanfang the answers we deserve.
It seems... that "time" is now. Watcher Liangyu, kindly let her through.
...Understood. I trust the Paragon's judgment.
Intendant, my apologies for the earlier offense... The Ministry of War's rules say you still need an escort to enter the Sanctum...
I'll go in with her.
I have no objection.
The Prism of Fate grants its bearer the authority to enter the Sanctum. Your presence there may be the variable that shifts everything.
And Qingxiao?
...I'll stay in the Hold. See to my duties as Xuan Paragon.
Hsin charged me to act in Her stead should the tide ever become irreversible. Now I see She meant more than just the chaos Muyu caused.
A Sentinel's waning frequency may spark trouble in the Hold. Someone must remain here to handle it.
The Sanctum's matters... and Hsin, I leave to you. I have faith in you.
...I understand.
I'll handle whatever's waiting for us in the Sanctum.
Go, then.
Be careful. In all things.

You find Intendant Suoming at the Sanctum entrance with the Wardens barring her way. She addresses you as Arbiter and knows you carry Hsin's Prism of Fate. When questioned, she states her purpose plainly: the Ministry has measured Hsin the Moon Fox's frequency and found it critically unstable. She may no longer be able to save even Herself. Suoming holds a covenant with Hsin, and the time has come for Her to honor it. The rumor of the Hold's collapse was Suoming's doing as well, a warning to give civilians time to evacuate should the worst occur. Qingxiao senses Hsin's frequency within Suoming's token, the Vermillion Lock, and confirms she is telling the truth. After some discussion, you agree to enter the Sanctum with Suoming to search for Hsin, while Qingxiao remains in the Hold to manage any fallout.
Come one, come all, don't miss out...
Moon Fox Rice Cakes, fresh out of the steamer!
That one over there... Don't they look like—
Shh. Big name out of Mengzhou City, has to be. Best keep our distance.
Think Lady Hsin will show up this year?
Nobody's heard a word about the Sentinel in years. I wouldn't count on it...
How come nobody came out to play today?
They're moving away, I heard... So it's only the two of us now...
Hi there, kitty...
There's been no warning. We aren't ready for any of this...
I'm sorry. It was sudden for us too. This is for your own safety...

Crates line the roadside, filled with Waking Moon Festival decorations and provisions. Somebody was counting them not long ago.
 
The people of Xuanfang have been waiting for this Festival for a long time.
Have evacuation routes ready, and make sure not to cause alarm.
Understood. And the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs?
I'll handle them. The people's safety comes first.
Why's the path to the Sanctum blocked? I thought they said the Celestial Ring Formation needed maintenance somewhere?
Somebody important showed up, is what I hear... No idea beyond that.
The Inner Threshold is inside Mengxuan Vale. This way, please.
After you.
Hold on.
...Someone repaired the anomaly in the Heart of Flames?
Thank the Sentinel...
With the Heart of Flames back, I've finally got hold of this corrupted data. Time to take it apart properly...
...Wait. This power came from the same source as Lady Hsin?
(Hm? Yao? What's she doing out here?)
So this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou today. I wouldn't have guessed...
The Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou?
You've been here before?
As with the Xuanyuan Domain you visited before, it's one of the Manifold Dimensions Hsin commands.
You seem to know my comings and goings very well.
The Ministry keeps a record of anything concerning the Sentinel's Sanctum, Arbiter.
I merely read of it in our Grand Library.
Supposedly, this place governs the base order of every mechanism in the Hold. It calculates the Manifold Forms, and you'd expect efficiency to come first, not extravagance.
But such intricate, lifelike scenery... is not what I anticipated. Still, for Hsin the Moon Fox, such style is no surprise.
It's like the Xuanyuan Domain... Hsin once told me that was only a small part of the <te href=800053>Civilization Capsule</te>...
What if... this place is connected to the Capsule as well?
I'm guessing by your reaction I'm right?
...The evidence is thin. I won't commit to an answer yet.

You emerge from the mist into a serene landscape of Xuanfang mountains and waterways. It is not what Suoming expected, and her face betrays her surprise. She tells you this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou—the framework that underpins Xuanfang Hold's fundamental order. You wonder if it might be connected to the Civilization Capsule. In the distance, among the peaks, a massive silhouette catches your eye.
(That silhouette on the horizon...)
(The mist is obscuring it, but it looks like... Hsin the Moon Fox?)
Is that...
...Sector <ano=Yang Fire and Yang Wood>Bing-Yin</ano> has three corrupted registers. Tracing from the old framework... There. All sorted.
And that disturbance earlier... resolved too. Phew, that was close...
(A phantom? No... the way she's dressed...)
(Could she be one of the <te href=852016>Celestials</te>, like Ruoyun?)
Wha-! Wh-who are you? How did you get in here?
We've come to see Hsin.
You're... the Arbiter?
...So you're Lady Hsin's guest. Pardon my manners.
And you are...?
I'm Mingxiao, a Court of Savantae Artisan here in the Simulacrum Nexus. I handle maintenance and repairs in this area. Ah... outside, I suppose you'd call us Celestials?
What's happened here?
Well... lately, structures have been collapsing for unknown reasons. It's started to disrupt the Hold's operations. We're fixing them as fast as we can.
Unknown reasons?
Yes. Ever since Lady Hsin decided to...
My apologies... the restrictions forbid me from answering. But please, rest assured, it's safe here.
Where is Hsin now?
Lady Hsin... isn't able to see guests now. You may wait at Mengxuan Vale for the time being.
...Follow me, please.
...Hmm.
Got something on your mind?

Our Grand Library records that Sentinel Hsin and the Court of Savantae agreed that once the Hold was complete, the Artisans would surrender their lives and become conscious frequencies woven into the mechanisms. Part of the Sanctum's computational power.
That meant losing their bodies, sense of self—everything that makes a person human.
And yet they... seem no different from anyone else. Not exactly what I expected.
Um... W-welcome to Mengxuan Vale.
This used to be a place for the Celestials to rest. But with the Simulacrum Nexus's data anomalies increasing, Lady Hsin set up repair workshops all over. This is one of them.
We so rarely have guests... do excuse us if we fall short. Whatever you'd like to know, Arbiter, I'll do my best to answer.
You knew I'd come?

Lady Hsin's Prism of Fate isn't something just anyone can carry. Once, she told us that if a black-haired, golden-eyed person ever came bearing it, we should answer {Male=his;Female=her} questions as fully as possible.
...And you match that description exactly.
I need to know where Hsin is now, as well as Her condition.
At this point... I'm not here to assign blame, but I'm done waiting for the moment to be "right." If Hsin the Moon Fox is caught in something, I'll find Her myself.
She's the Sentinel. Her every move could affect Xuanfang Hold's safety.

That's... I understand your worry. It's just, Lady Hsin's power of Fractal Proliferation lets her exist across the entire Sanctum to guide the Hold's operations. And lately, with all the repairs, She's busier than ever...
Even we... have not seen Lady Hsin's true form in a long time.
Over there on the horizon. What is it?

...That is the <te href=852015>Nexus Fox Shadow</te>, one of the Sentinel's manifestations. It resides outside the Simulacrum Nexus, occasionally acting on the Sentinel's behalf to... oversee matters.
Do you know why we're here?
To see Lady Hsin, surely?
Of all the Sentinels in Huanglong, none are more "willful" than Hsin the Moon Fox. But She is not one to treat a covenant lightly.
Xuanfang Hold is complete. The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs should have reclaimed the Civilization Capsule long ago. Hsin delayed. Again and again. Now the final term is past.
As an Intendant in the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, I have come to take it back. Will She yet hide from me?
Hsin?
(No, that gesture... is it a "threat"?)
So this is what you've all been refusing to name.
That response is answer enough. What you cannot say, I will learn for myself.
Forgive me... nothing in the Sanctum escapes Lady Hsin. She must already know you've come.
But we can't say for certain when you'll be able to see Her. While you wait for Her response, do explore as you like.
I still have repairs to attend to. I'll take my leave.
Thanks for your explanation.
I see.
(What's wrong?)
(Got jolted awake by some huge frequency wave! It was kinda like... that Prism of Fate, but with all these extra nasty, funky smells. Ugh...)
(Is it coming from that Fox Shadow on the horizon?)
(Uh-huh! Whatever's there has been giving me the willies since we got here. Like something's spying on me... Creepy. So I'm staying inside. If things get hairy, just holler!)
(Okay. Got it.)
(It seems like the Celestials here are bound by restrictions, just like Ruoyun was.)
(Now that I'm inside the Sanctum, I should take a look around.)

Inside Mengxuan Vale, Mingxiao explains that this area once served as a resting place for the Celestials, but it's now home to repair workshops for Celestials to fix anomalies. Hsin left instructions here long ago, and they have been waiting for the Arbiter ever since. Hsin, however, has been so consumed with keeping Xuanfang Hold running that she has not appeared before them in a long time. You learn that the great shadow on the horizon is called the Nexus Fox Shadow, a manifestation Hsin uses to oversee matters in her stead. But the Celestials refuse to say more about it. Suoming cuts to the point: she has come to reclaim the Civilization Capsule Hsin used to raise the Hold. No sooner are the words out than the shadow stirs, lifting a single finger to its lips. It is not an answer. It is a warning. Sensing that Mingxiao is bound by Celestial restrictions and cannot speak freely, you decide to investigate on your own first.
Hm? And you are...?
Oh! You must be that Arbiter Lady Hsin told us about! I never imagined someone from the outside world could make it in here...
How are things in the Hold these days? Is the Land of Xuanfang still safe?
(Briefly explain how things stand.)
So much has happened...
None of you knew what was going on out there?
No. Beyond the information needed to keep the Hold running, we Celestials barely interact across sectors, let alone with the world beyond the Sanctum.
Lady Hsin calls it "modular management," I think. She doesn't seem to like it much... but it is a restriction set from the Hold's founding. We've all come to accept it.

It's alright. We're used to it. I thought becoming a Celestial would turn me into a heartless program, but Lady Hsin told us this place runs on "emotion" as its support, so She's been splitting off computational power just to keep our sense of self intact.
To ease the strain on our minds, we have no sense of time passing. I don't know how long it's been. The horror of the Fortress and Gorges War still feels like yesterday...
Thank you for telling me how Xuanfang is doing.
Well, I've rested enough. Time to get back to my modular parts and my duties.
...Oh, and, Arbiter, the Lady Hsin of today is already... Ngh.
Are you all right?
Never mind... Sorry. It is a rare chance to be here. Please, take your time exploring.
(That reaction... is he afraid of the Fox Shadow?)

The Celestials in the Sanctum do not perceive the passage of time, a mercy that spares their minds the burden of the years. But becoming a Celestial did not strip them of their humanity. They still carry the full range of human emotion and seem no different from the living. One of them tells you this was Hsin's doing. She once told them that the Sanctum runs on "emotion" as its support. All this time, she has been diverting her own computational power to preserve their sense of self, and it seems she has been bearing other pressures alongside it.
Back when the Sentinel's computational power was still strong, She would often conjure Fractal Forms to come and amuse us in our workshops. "To keep us from getting bored," She said.
And She would tell all sorts of stories and gossip from Xuanfang. She never could resist a good joke. Some had us laughing for days... Others, ahem, had us spinning for days.
Not what you would expect from a Sentinel, is it? But that's exactly why, through all this, we haven't lost ourselves.
A Celestial's frequency... does wear down over time. And yet, not one of us has ever been lost. Not one.
Oh, what am I supposed to do now...
You look troubled.
It's these anomalies, what else... Oh, sorry, I thought you were... Wait. You're the Arbiter, aren't you?! I'm Leyue, I'm in charge of Autopuppet repairs here.
...Does everyone here know who I am?
Of course! The Sentinel told us to keep nothing from you. Let me guess, you want to know about the anomalies?
That's right.
Let me just take you to see it. It's... a bit complicated.
What's happened to these Celestials?
The anomalies have affected their consciousness. They're riddled with errors now... There's nothing we can do.
...This is the place.
Anomalies like this were rare in the early days, but the few that cropped up, Lady Hsin would fix quickly.
Why does this happen?
Lady Hsin said it's redundant data from repairing modular parts. But the root source... we've never been able to trace it.

It seems to originate from the highest level of clearance. We cannot intervene. We can only wait for Lady Hsin to fix it Herself. And there are even more anomalies like this in the <te href=852012>Heart Realms</te>.
Heart Realms?

They make up the innermost region of the Simulacrum Nexus, storing not only Xuanfang's history and culture, but also the Sentinel's own memories. Projections of Xuanfang's fate, its web of possibilities... Everything is held in Lady Hsin's keeping.
We Celestials don't have the authority to enter the Heart Realms, so we can't fix the anomalies there. Right now, three Heart Realms are still in chaos.
There's no way for us to share Her burden. All we can do is... Hold on. That frequency, it's...
Th-this is Lady Hsin's power! Then maybe... Arbiter, come with me. Quickly!

Leyue leads you to one of the anomalies and explains that it appears to originate from the highest clearance level. There is nothing the Celestials can do but wait for Hsin to repair it Herself. And anomalies like this are far more numerous within the Heart Realms, where Xuanfang's history, culture, projected futures, and the Sentinel's own memories are all stored, all of it answerable only to Hsin the Moon Fox. It is then that you discover the Prism of Fate can restore any Celestial affected by the anomalies.
